title: Remote viewing Joan of Arc

tellings.quote: Oh, things like um Jon of Arc.

plain: In the 1980s, the claim goes, remote viewers, people trained to try to perceive distant places and times with the mind alone, were given Joan of Arc as a target. A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan, who did this work, names her to Michels as one of the kinds of targets he viewed, though he gives no more detail. It would mean the practice was aimed not just at places but at people of the distant past.
